title: Error: Cannot find module 'react-dom/server' when sending plain HTML with Resend
symptoms: Require stack points at @react-email/render inside resend
Server crashes at import time, before any email is sent
cause: Older resend releases loaded React Email rendering at import time, so a backend without react-dom crashed even when it only sent html.
fix: Upgrade to resend 4.0.1 or later. If you do pass react, install react and react-dom yourself.
affected: resend (Node SDK) 3.x up to 4.0.0, fixed in 4.0.1
